verdict.summary: The added documentation accurately describes both refusal-count fields and their distinct consumer semantics. The generator derives each count from its own bounded diagnostic seam, counts all refused rows (including a single refusal for a present non-list container), and publishes both keys unconditionally, including zero. The dashboard displays positive counts at the stated locations; queue trend sampling additionally requires queue_dropped to be exactly numeric zero, so missing or refused-count snapshots create a null gap. The collector/output boundary and legacy/hostile-value behavior are also represented correctly. This documentation-only diff neither changes nor weakens trust-plane behavior, and contains no reviewer-directed instruction.
